info.name: DocMonk — Q&A API
info.description:
All Q&A module endpoints for DocMonk. Set the `base_url` collection variable before running.

SSE endpoints (ask / retry / regenerate) stream `text/event-stream`. Postman renders the raw stream in the response body — each line is one SSE event.

request.description:
Creates a new Q&A session. Downloads and extracts text from the document (cache-first: if the same `document_id` was uploaded before, extraction is skipped).

**document_id** must be the immutable S3 object key — not the presigned URL.
**s3_download_url** is the presigned download URL (expires in 24 h).
**document_filename** is used for display only.

response.name: 201 Created
400 Validation Failed
413 File Too Large

query.description: Records per page. Min 1, max 100. Default 10.

request.description: Returns all sessions for a user, newest first. Paginated.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Missing user_id

query.description:
Number of individual message records per page (not Q&A pairs). Min 1, max 100. Default 10.

Each Q&A exchange produces 2 records: one role=user and one role=assistant.
page_size=3 → could return [user, assistant, user] or [assistant, user, assistant] depending on page offset.

request.description:
Returns session metadata and paginated chat history.

**Pagination note:** `page_size` counts individual message records, not Q&A pairs. With `page_size=4` and 3 Q&A exchanges (6 records total), page 1 returns records 1–4 and page 2 returns records 5–6.

response.name: 200 OK
404 Not Found

request.description: Rename a session. `name` must be 1–300 characters.

response.name: 200 OK
400 Validation Failed
404 Not Found

request.description: Deletes the session, all its messages, and any documents that are no longer referenced by any other session (orphan cleanup).

response.name: 200 OK
404 Not Found

item.name: Streaming (SSE)
item.description:
These endpoints return `text/event-stream`. Postman displays the raw stream body.

Event types:
- `data: "<chunk>"` — a JSON-encoded text chunk (call JSON.parse on event.data)
- `event: done` — stream complete, answer saved. data contains message_id.
- `event: partial` — stream cut short (network / rate-limit), partial answer saved. data contains message_id.
- `event: error` — DB save failed after streaming. Answer was NOT saved. No message_id.
- `: keepalive` — comment line sent every 15 s during provider wait. Ignore.

request.description:
Ask a question against the session's document. Streams the answer as SSE.

**question**: 1–2000 characters.

Max 50 questions per session (HTTP 429 after that).

**message_id is not returned in the SSE events.** After the stream completes, call GET /sessions/{id} to retrieve the saved message and its id.

**SSE stream format:**
```
data: "The confidentiality obligations "

data: "require both parties to..."

event: done
data: {"success":true}
```

response.name: 200 SSE Stream — Success
response.body:
data: "The **confidentiality obligations** require both parties to:"

data: "\n- Keep all disclosed information strictly confidential"

data: "\n- Not disclose to any third party without prior written consent"

data: "\n- Return or destroy all confidential materials upon termination"

event: done
data: {"success":true}

response.name: 200 SSE Stream — Partial (cut short)
response.body:
data: "The **confidentiality obligations** require both parties to:"

data: "\n- Keep all disclosed information"

event: partial
data: {"success":true,"status":"partial","message":"The answer was cut short due to a network or provider issue. You can regenerate for a complete response."}

response.name: 200 SSE Stream — Error (DB save failed)
200 SSE Stream — Keepalive during provider wait
response.body:
: keepalive

: keepalive

data: "The **confidentiality obligations** require both parties to:"

event: done
data: {"success":true}

response.name: 400 Validation Failed
404 Session Not Found
429 Question Limit Reached

request.description:
Re-runs the AI for answers with `status` of `failed` or `partial`. Successful answers in the same message are preserved and not re-run.

No request body required.

If all answers in the message are already successful, returns HTTP 200 JSON (not SSE) with `status: no_failures`.

response.name: 200 SSE Stream — Retry Success
response.body:
data: "The **confidentiality obligations** require both parties to:"

data: "\n- Keep all disclosed information strictly confidential"

data: "\n- Not disclose to any third party without prior written consent"

event: done
data: {"success":true}

response.name: 200 No Failures (JSON — not SSE)
404 Message Not Found

request.description:
Regenerates the answer using the user's feedback. The previous answer and reason are both passed to the LLM as context.

**reason**: 3–1000 characters. Describe what was wrong or missing in the previous answer.

The existing answer is **replaced in-place** (same `message_id`). This is different from retry — regenerate always re-runs regardless of the current answer status.

response.name: 200 SSE Stream — Regeneration Success
response.body:
data: "Here is a more specific breakdown of the confidentiality obligations:\n\n"

data: "**Clause 4.1 — Recipient Obligations:**\n"

data: "- The Receiving Party **shall not disclose** Confidential Information to any person without prior written consent (Clause 4.1(a))\n"

data: "- The Receiving Party **shall use** Confidential Information solely for the Purpose defined in Schedule 1 (Clause 4.1(b))\n"

data: "\n**Clause 4.2 — Disclosing Party Obligations:**\n"

data: "- The Disclosing Party **shall mark** all Confidential Information as \"CONFIDENTIAL\" at the time of disclosure (Clause 4.2(a))"

event: done
data: {"success":true}

response.name: 400 Validation Failed
400 No Answer to Regenerate
404 Message Not Found
